items.title: Rebuilding search visibility for an independent HVAC company
items.text: A ground-up Google Business Profile and local SEO structure for a trades business competing against national franchises on search — the kind of groundwork most local businesses are missing.

items.title: A new identity and site for a boutique fitness studio
items.text: Brand identity and a conversion-focused website built around class bookings and trial sign-ups, replacing a generic template site that wasn't built to sell anything.

items.title: AI review follow-up for a multi-location practice
items.text: Automated, on-brand review requests and a first-response chatbot designed to handle the repetitive enquiries that were previously eating up front-desk time.

items.title: Rebuilding a wasted ad budget for a local plumbing company
items.text: A campaign restructure aimed at emergency call-out searches instead of broad, expensive keywords that were burning budget without producing enquiries.

items.title: A conversion-focused rebuild for an independent dental practice
items.text: Replacing an outdated site with a fast, mobile-first build structured around booking enquiries rather than a static About page nobody reads.
